And we are in the final price negotiations closure stage for the large volume of the order. I mean we should close within next 30 days to 45 days time, and we'll announce the sale with it.

capex.statement: RMC business uses capital-light lease-based model with zero capex for plants
capex.quote: Importantly, we are adopting a capital-light lease-based model that enables us to scale without significant investment in fixed assets. We believe this is the right way to build the business.

capex.statement: Wind energy indigenous manufacturing plant operational in 12-14 months, margin impact after 18-24 months
capex.quote: Manufacturing plant should be operational within 12 to 14 months. And there will be a real impact of that will take an other 6 months after that on the profitability. Certainly, that will be a good impact on the profitability, after 1 year, 1.5 years in the books of account.

risk.statement: Monsoon impacts Q2 ash handling volumes (35,000-40,000 MT in Q2 vs 90,000 target); seasonal revenue fluctuation expected
risk.quote: This Q2 was quite less. It was around 35,000 to 40,000. And volume started going up, though there in some part, there was a tsunami or the rain going on for last 1 week, but volume started going up.

other.statement: Pune RMC plant targeting 4,000-4,500 cubic meters per month
other.quote: We should anticipate volumes of almost about 4,000, 4,500 cubic meters per month from this plant alone.

other.statement: India installed wind capacity reached 59.2 GW as of Sep 2026
other.quote: As a result, the country total installed wind capacity reached 59.2 gigawatts as on September 2026.

guidance.statement: Operating cash flow for FY27 expected to be higher than FY26
guidance.quote: We remain confident of sustaining healthy cash flows in the coming quarters and outlook to generate operating cash flow from operations for the entire financial year higher than that of FY26.

guidance.statement: Reiterated FY27 presales guidance of INR9,000 crores; H1 achieved ~INR2,900 crores, targeting ~INR7,000 crores in H2
guidance.quote: For now, we reiterate the INR9,000 crores presales guidance.

guidance.statement: Expects FY27 residential revenue recognition of ~INR5,000 crores with EBITDA margin 22-24%
guidance.quote: It should be INR5,000 crores in rough order of magnitude.

guidance.statement: Office portfolio to grow from 9.5M to 12.5M sq ft operational by FY29; rental income expected ~INR1,700 cr in FY29
guidance.quote: By FY29, we expect that to grow to 12.4 million square feet. So if I add even the retail, there we'll be adding a smaller amount. So I would just say 12.5 million square feet, you can expect from 9.5 million to 12.5 million.

demand.statement: Residential demand remains strong; IT sector job losses not impacting demand as talent shifts to GCCs; premiumization trend continues
demand.quote: We've been maintaining for a long time that despite the net hiring in IT and IT sector and certain companies not being positive, it has not really impacted demand. In fact, demand has actually become more premium while also maintaining growth.

margin.statement: FY27 Real Estate EBITDA margin expected 22-24%
margin.quote: So the margin profile of the entire FY27 would -- in real estate would be in that early 20s, between 22% and 24%, which is what was there in H1 as well.

margin.statement: Consolidated EBITDA margin improved to 38% in Q2 FY27 from 26% in Q2 FY26 (+1,200 bps); Real Estate EBITDA margin 24% vs 12% YoY
margin.quote: Consolidated revenue for the quarter stood at INR1,250 crores with EBITDA of INR478 crores. The EBITDA margin improved to 38% compared with 26% in Q2 of FY26, an improvement of 1,200 basis points.

order_book.statement: H2 launch pipeline of 7 million sq ft with GDV of INR7,600 crores; includes 2 large Bengaluru townships (~INR3,800 crores combined), 1M sq ft each in Chennai and Hyderabad
order_book.quote: We have INR9,800 crores of inventory in addition to another 7 million square feet or INR7,600 crores Gross Developmental Value (GDV) of launches planned for the second half of the financial year.

order_book.statement: H1 business development added ~12.5-13M sq ft (~INR13,000 cr GDV); balance land payable ~INR2,000+ cr over ~1 year (some JDA milestone-dependent)
order_book.quote: We have added about 12.5 million, 13 million square feet totally in this financial year for the first half, of which close to about 10 million square feet has come in Q2. This would approximately translate to about INR13,000 crores of GDV.

capex.statement: Office capex phasing: INR400 cr in H2 FY27, INR1,500 cr in FY28, INR1,500 cr in FY29; post-FY29 projects include WTC Hyderabad, Brigade Industrial Park, Brigade Icon commercial
capex.quote: Balance capex we have to spend for the office in the remaining H2 of '27 is about INR400 crores. In '28, we are expected to spend about INR1,500 crores. And in '29, we're expected to spend another INR1,500 crores.

capex.statement: Land payments INR440 cr in Q2 split ~half Bengaluru, half Hyderabad; West & East Bengaluru focus
capex.quote: It's almost half and half between Bangalore and Hyderabad.

pricing_cost.statement: Average realization up 29% YoY to INR13,841/sq ft driven by disciplined pricing and premium mix shift
pricing_cost.quote: Average realization stood at INR13,841 per square foot, a strong 29% year-on-year improvement, driven by disciplined pricing increases in our existing projects and a sustained shift in contribution of higher-end homes in our overall product mix.

pricing_cost.statement: WTC Bengaluru & Twin Towers re-leasing at ~15% higher rents; annual escalations ~5%
pricing_cost.quote: New leases that we are doing, we are re-leasing the same space at around 15% higher than what it was getting us.

product_mix.statement: H2 launches skewed to INR1-2 cr ticket size (sweet spot); Bengaluru projects largely INR1-1.5 cr (North) and INR2 cr; ~20% at INR3 cr
product_mix.quote: Some of our upcoming launches are in that INR1 crores to INR2 crores range, which is a sweet spot for many customers, especially in Bangalore and Chennai.

fund_raise.statement: Bain Capital invested in SPV Vibrancy Real Estates; entity reclassified from subsidiary to JV, investment accounted via equity method (INR317 cr)
fund_raise.quote: So this is investment which came from Bain Capital's fund in first quarter in a SPV called Vibrancy Real Estates Private Limited.

risk.statement: Chennai launch approvals may slip to next fiscal due to government change; one of two Q4 projects at risk
risk.quote: The other one, we're still working to try and get it within Q4, but that one might get pushed out into the next financial year.

other.statement: Retail: Orion Mall portfolio 94% trading occupancy; retailer sales +16% YoY; footfall steady
other.quote: Our Orion Mall portfolio delivered a steady quarter at 94% trading occupancy. Retailer sales across the portfolio grew 16% year-on-year, led by stronger electronics and restaurant sales, while mall footfall remained steady.

other.statement: Facility Management (Aureya): manages 16M sq ft, revenue INR71 cr, EBITDA 30%
other.quote: Aureya FM Services, our in-house facility management company now manages 16 million square feet with a revenue of INR71 crores and EBITDA of 30% in this quarter.

guidance.statement: Exports expected to sustain at ~7.5 lakh units per quarter
guidance.quote: We expect to sustain this going forward.

demand.statement: Domestic 2W industry grew 18% YoY in Apr-Aug; festive Sep-Dec expected double-digit but lower than 18% due to base effect
demand.quote: 2 -wheeler industry, including electric scooters, demonstrated healthy Y oY growth of 18% in April to August

demand.statement: EV scooter penetration at 25% of scooter category; Chetak retail hit 45,000 in September despite capacity constraints
demand.quote: The industry continued to grow rapidly at 75% plus in Q2 and penetration of electric scooters is now 25% of the scooter category.

order_book.statement: Exports crossed 7.8 lakh units in Q2 FY27, up 41% YoY; second consecutive quarter above 7 lakh
order_book.quote: The BU crossed its highest ever volume of 7.8 lakh units in Q2, a growth of 41% year -on-year. This is the second consecutive quarter above 7,00,000 units.

capex.statement: Overall capacity expanding from 6.25 lakh to 7.75 lakh units per month over next 6-9 months
capex.quote: The overall capacity of 6,25,000 units per month is being expanded to about 7,75,000 units per month over the next 6 to 9 months in a phased manner.

pricing_cost.statement: Input cost inflation impact 3-3.5% of revenue in Q2; cumulative H1 impact exceptionally steep
pricing_cost.quote: Taken together, the impact of commodity and other input cost inflation in quarter 2 was in the whereabouts of between 3% and 3.5% of revenue.

pricing_cost.statement: Calibrated pricing covered 50-60% of H1 inflation impact; balance offset by currency and cost optimization
pricing_cost.quote: We have responded through calibrated pricing actions, which really have covered about between 50% and 60% of the inflationary impact over this first half.

product_mix.statement: Two new brands spanning 125-250cc planned for launch in FY27; Pulsar portfolio refresh targeted by end of festive
product_mix.quote: In addition, we will have 2 new brands in the pipeline, spanning the 125cc to 250cc space getting lined up for launch in FY27.

product_mix.statement: New Pulsar launches (125, 150, 160 upgrades) now 33% of 125cc+ portfolio in early festive, up from 7% in August
product_mix.quote: The share of new launches in our 125cc plus portfolio was 7% in August. It grew to 26% in September. And in the first 16 days of festive, it has further grown to 33%.

risk.statement: Input cost inflation persists into Q3 across metals, proprietary parts, electrical components; magnitude hard to quantify
risk.quote: We've entered the third consecutive quarter of an exceptionally challenging operating environment with input cost inflation, showing no real signs or immediate signs of easing.

risk.statement: Currency headwind if INR stays below 95; will not take pricing to cover currency moves
risk.quote: if the currency were to be a bit of a headwind, we will not take pricing action to cover currency movement because we know it's a very short-term transient measure.

other.statement: Chetak capacity expanding to 80,000 per month by Q4 FY27
other.quote: We are expanding Chetak capacity to 80,000 per month by quarter 4, which will help us get market share and unlock new reach.

other.statement: Realized USD/INR at 95.5 in Q2 vs 94.4 in Q1 and 87.1 YoY; October realizations below 95.5
other.quote: The rupee depreciated through quarter 2 with our realized USD INR rate coming in at INR95.5 versus 94.4 in the previous quarter and 87.1 in the same quarter last year.

guidance.statement: 18% CAGR targeted over next 2-3 years supported by CapEx projects and mining reserves
guidance.quote: The 18% CAGR is definitely in place with the projects and the mining reserves we have started to acquire. Given the unpredictability in the current situation, which will hopefully smooth out in the coming quarters, that should help us regain the CAGR we have anticipated over the next two to three years.

guidance.statement: Revenue growth expected to continue in H2 FY27; no specific FY27 revenue or margin numbers given due to market unpredictability
guidance.quote: No, we are not able to as of now, because of the current situation in the markets. It is quite unpredictable, and costs are also difficult to project. So we cannot put out a specific figure, but it will definitely be better than H1, for sure

capex.statement: Malaysia quarry capacity expansion from 4,000 MT to 8,000 MT expected by FY29; plant commencement by FY30
capex.quote: On the Malaysia project, it is already ongoing. We are working on the quarry part, raising capacity from 4,000 MT to 8,000 MT, which we expect to achieve by FY29, and by FY30 the plant should also commence.

capex.statement: ₹100 crore CapEx programme 30% deployed; further ₹17 crore in Q3 FY27 on solar; funded by internal accruals and selective debt over 24 months
capex.quote: Let me now update you on our ₹100 crore CapEx programme. So far, we have deployed around 30% of the programme. This includes ₹12 crores on captive solar and ₹7 crores on the two mining acquisitions. In the current quarter, we expect to deploy a further ₹17 crores, all of it on solar. That will take us to nearly half of the programme by Q3. The CapEx programme is being funded through internal accru

pricing_cost.statement: Furnace oil cost rose 33% (₹42 to ₹56/kg) impacting ₹1.34 crore; gas cost rose 77% (₹69 to ₹122/kg) impacting ₹0.62 crore; freight/MT rose 11% (₹2,108 to ₹2,346) impacting ₹2.92 crore in Q2 FY27
pricing_cost.quote: In Q1, the furnace oil rate was around ₹42 per kg, and it has risen to ₹56 per kg – a rise of about 33%, an impact of ₹1.34 crores. Gas has risen from ₹69 to ₹122 per kg, around 77%, an impact of ₹0.62 crores. Freight per metric tonne has gone from ₹2,108 to ₹2,346, an 11% rise, an impact of around ₹2.92 crores.

product_mix.statement: Specialty products already contributing to margins; 20 Microns Nano grew double-digit with higher profitability in Q2 FY27
product_mix.quote: The specialty products have already started to contribute to margins. You have to look at 20 Microns on a consolidated basis – if you look at 20 Microns Nano as an individual company, it has grown in double digits this quarter and its profitability has also increased.

risk.statement: Q3/Q4 margins hard to predict due to supply-chain disruptions, wars and upcoming midterm elections; wait-and-watch approach
risk.quote: For Q3 and Q4, as I mentioned, it is very hard to predict – not only for us but for all industries – given the ongoing supply-chain disruptions, the wars and the upcoming midterm elections. We don't know what's ahead, so it's a wait-and-watch situation; we hope things don't get worse.

other.statement: 9 MW captive solar plant (5.5 MW Rajasthan, 3.5 MW Gujarat) targeting Q4 FY27 commissioning; to meet ~40% power needs
other.quote: We are building 9 MW of captive solar capacity across two plants – 5.5 MW in Rajasthan and 3.5 MW in Gujarat. The total investment is about ₹29 crores and we are targeting commissioning in the fourth quarter of this financial year. Once running, solar should meet about 40% of our power needs.

other.statement: EBITDA margins consistently between 12-14% for over a decade despite pandemic, supply-chain disruptions and energy/freight cost swings
other.quote: Through a pandemic, supply-chain disruptions and sharp swings in energy and freight costs, our EBITDA margins have stayed between 12% and 14% year after year for over a decade.

guidance.statement: 30 GW target by 2030 underwritten by locked-in pipeline; growth beyond 2030 driven by Salboni thermal, 920 MW Punatsangchhu-III hydro (Bhutan), pumped storage 26.4 GWh, thermal & C&I opportunities.
guidance.quote: Looking further ahead, our locked -in pipeline gives us clear line of sight to our 30 GW target for 2030, and our growth runway extends well beyond it. demand.statement: Power demand grew 11.1% YoY in Q2 FY27, with September up 11.3% and October month-to-date up 21.2%; management sees structural drivers supporting 5-6% long-term CAGR.
demand.quote: Power demand in Q2 FY27 grew about 11.1% year -on-year, building on 8.3% growth in Q1. September alone grew about 11.3%, with peak demand touching 270 GW in Q2FY27. The momentum strengthened further into October, with month-to-date demand growth of 21.2%.

margin.statement: Utkal thermal plant EBITDA more than tripled YoY to ₹368 crore in Q2 FY27, driven by better plant performance and PPA realisations well above DAM prices.
margin.quote: Utkal had an exceptional quarter, now that it operates under long -term PPAs. Plant EBITDA more than tripled year -on-year to ₹368 crore in Q2 FY27, and grew over 60% YoY in H1 FY27. This was driven by significantly better plant performance and by PPA realisations well above the DAM prices at which the plant's power was sold a year ago.

capex.statement: Planned capex for FY27 is around ₹20,000 crore to support the 3 GW commissioning target and 1 GWh of energy storage projects.
capex.quote: The pipeline is substantially de-risked, and we are confident of achieving our 3 GW commissioning target for FY27, supported by planned capex of around ₹20,000 crore. Further, on our energy storage pursuits, we expect to commission about 1 GWh of projects in FY27.

capex.statement: KSK Mahanadi 1.8 GW expansion capex 25-30% below industry benchmark per MW due to ready balance-of-plant infrastructure for 3.6 GW.
capex.quote: See, as we have said that the balance of plant in KSK has been ready. And in the last earnings call also, I have mentioned about this that the capex per MW for the capacity addition of 1.8 GW at Mahanadi plant will be significantly lower than the industry benchmark. So when we say that the investment in Mahanadi expansion, doubling the capacity will be at least 25% to 30% lower cost per MW capex a

pricing_cost.statement: Merchant realisation averaged ₹6.9/kWh in Q2 FY27, ~20% above DAM average of ₹5.7/kWh; Q3 fully booked at similar or better pricing.
pricing_cost.quote: Day-Ahead Market prices averaged ₹5.7 per unit in Q2 FY27. Our merchant realisation, however, stood around ₹6.9 per unit which was around 20% higher than the DAM average, driven by the strategic bilateral contracts we have entered into.

fund_raise.statement: ₹10,150 crore capital unlocked in calendar year via fundraising and JSW Steel share sale; ICRA and India Ratings affirmed AA/Stable rating.
fund_raise.quote: ICRA and India Ratings have affirmed JSW Energy's long-term credit rating at AA with a Stable outlook. This recognises our larger and more diversified operating base, our high share of contracted capacity, and the d eleveraging we delivered through the ₹10,150 crore capital unlocking in this calendar year

risk.statement: Merchant exposure limited to ~4% of capacity (7% of energy); Q3 fully booked at similar or better rates; evening peak opportunity may keep part of Mahanadi capacity merchant.
risk.quote: Yes. Definitely, third quarter is fully booked. And maybe I'll not comment on the pricing, but the pricing discovered may be either same or better than this, not lower than these for quarter 3. And now the discussions are on for quarter 4. Normally, it is 2-2.5 months back before this planning start. There are discussions going on even for quarter 4, but quarter 3 is fully booked.

other.statement: API4 imported coal prices averaged ~US$115/t in Q2 FY27, up 28% YoY; shift to domestic coal and job-work arrangements insulated fuel costs.
other.quote: API4 benchmark coal prices averaged close to US$115 per tonne in Q2 FY27, up around 28% year-on-year from US$90 per tonne. Despite this increase, our transition to domestic coal and the implementation of job -work arrangements at imported -coal plants, which shield us from fuel-price volatility, have enabled us to effectively mitigate the impact and maintain cost competitiveness.

other.statement: Curtailment at 4.8% of generation in H1 (national 5.4%); Q2 curtailed ~225 MUs, revenue impact ₹59 crore; 60% of curtailed capacity on temporary GNA to move to permanent GNA by end Q3 FY27.
other.quote: Curtailment across our portfolio stood at about 4.8% of total generation in H1, below the national level curtailment of about 5.4%. In Q2, our curtailed units stood at ~225 MUs with a Revenue impact of Rupees 59 Crores. Further, about 60% of our curtailed capacity currently on temporary GNA will move to permanent GNA by the end of Q3 FY27, which should reduce our exposure meaningfully.

guidance.statement: EBITDA per ton guidance maintained at INR9,000-12,000 for foreseeable future
guidance.quote: Our guidance remains INR9,000 to INR12,000 as EBITDA per ton.

guidance.statement: Full-year sales volume target revised to ~260,000 tons
guidance.quote: So, we expect sales of about 260,000 tons now for the year. Budget was about 260,000 tons.

demand.statement: Strong demand driven by auto (2W, SUV, PV) and non-auto; tractors showing slight slowdown
demand.quote: Demand was strong. And pa rtly demand has been strong because of the GST cuts, which happened last year on 2-wheelers as well as the smaller vehicles as well as SUV sales have been good

margin.statement: Kocks Block & reheating furnace raised capacity to 300KTPA, improved yields, cut job work, boosted margin
margin.quote: So, with the combination of Kocks Block and reheating furnace, we have been able to increase our capacity to 300,000 tons. And we can actually increase this capacity even beyond this.

capex.statement: New steel plant cost to exceed INR2,000 crore; forging plant capex lower than budgeted INR475 crore
capex.quote: But suffice it to say at this point in time that the project cost will be higher than the INR2,000 crores that we had envisaged.

capex.statement: Existing plant capex ~INR150 crore per year; brownfield expansion to 360KTPA needs ~INR100-115 crore
capex.quote: It will be about INR150 crores for the existing plant. And for the steel plant, as I said, we are still considering the final figures that will be investing.

pricing_cost.statement: Price increase letters of INR3,500-4,000/ton sent for Q3; Q2 settlements ongoing
pricing_cost.quote: The other companies have sent out letters for price increases, which are ranging between INR3,500 to INR4,000 a ton.

product_mix.statement: Seeding non-auto segments (tool & die, oil & gas, railways, bearings) via ingot casting from Nov 2026
product_mix.quote: So, we are starting with ingot casting, which is the route to make specialized stee ls. This is something that we will start in the end of November, it will

risk.statement: Project implementation risk cited as biggest risk; no new competitor capacity expected for 2-3 years
risk.quote: There are several risks. One, there's a project implementation risk. Two, I think that's the biggest risk that we have.

other.statement: Receivables up due to higher sales in Aug-Sep; debtor days increased 4-5 days
other.quote: In number of days, it has increased by 4 to 5 days only because of some sales to customers who are having a high credit period.

other.statement: Solar expansion of 22.5 MW (20 MW for current plant, 2.5 MW for forging NDT line)
other.quote: And we are now expanding the solar plant by another 22.5 megawatts. 20 -megawatt for this will be for the current plant and 2.5 -megawatt will be for the NDT line.

demand.statement: 5G subscriber base grew 36 million in Q1 to exceed 463 million, driving sustained operator investment
demand.quote: According to the recent TRAI data, India's 5G subscriber base grew by 36 million in the first quarter, exceeding 463 million subscribers.

demand.statement: Industry added ~30,000 5G BTS in Q2, total installed base ~593,000; focus shifting to densification
demand.quote: With the industry adding approximately 30,000 5G BTS s during the second quarter, taking the total installed base to around 593,000.

demand.statement: Total data volume up 30% YoY in Q1; 5G usage up 79% YoY, now 44% of total consumption
demand.quote: In Q1, total data volume increased by 30% year -on-year, supported by an 18% rise in average monthly usage per subscriber. Notably, 5G networks are accelerating this trend, with 5G usage alone growing 79% year-on-year, representing 44% of total data consumption, up from 32% in the prior year.

margin.statement: Reported EBITDA grew 2.5% QoQ to INR46.3bn; EBITDA margin improved 80bps QoQ to 54.4%
margin.quote: Reported EBITDA increased by 2.5% quarter-on-quarter and stands at INR46.3 billion for the quarter. Our EBITDA margin also improved by 80 basis points quarter-on-quarter and stands at 54.4% for the quarter.

margin.statement: Energy margin improved to -3.6% in Q2 from -4.6% in Q1 and -4.8% YoY; diesel consumption down 11% YoY
margin.quote: Our energy margin was negative 3.6% in Q2 compared to negative of 4.6% in Q1 and negative 4.8% in the corresponding quarter of last year, reflecting a significant improvement during the reported quarter. Our structured energy efficiency measures are yielding positive results, and diesel consumption is further reduced by 11% year-on-year.

order_book.statement: Added ~2,900 macro towers and 7,900 co-locations in Q2; tower base ~270,500, co-location base ~440,200
order_book.quote: We added approximately 2,900 macro towers and robust co-locations of 7,900, marking year -on-year growth of 5.6% in towers and 5.9% in co-locations. Our total macro tower and co-location base reached approximately 270,500 and 440,200, respectively.

order_book.statement: Strong order book visibility from major customers driving tower and tenancy growth
order_book.quote: we do have a visibility of a strong order book. And I think we will keep executing based on that order book. So yo u'll continue to see our delivery in the line with what the orders we have

capex.statement: Growth capex increase reflected in CWIP rising ~INR250 cr QoQ due to healthy order book; capex includes towers, tenancies, 5G upgrades, solar
capex.quote: If you follow our balance sheet, there is an increase of around INR250-odd crores on the CWIP value quarter-on-quarter, which is a reflection of what Prachur was alluding on the very healthy order book what we have.

capex.statement: Africa tower deployments commenced in Zambia and Uganda in Q2; Nigeria deployment starting in Q3; early capex per tower within plan
capex.quote: We have successfully deployed towers in Zambia and Uganda in Q2 and also started generating revenue. In line with our phased rollout plan, we are set to begin deployment in Nigeria during the current quarter and our early capex performance per tower remains within the plan, validating our cost model during the initial phases.

pricing_cost.statement: Annual rental escalation covers majority of inflation impact on opex; capex rates revised per MSA where flexibility exists
pricing_cost.quote: I think first is the escalation that we have that takes care of the inflation impact when it comes to opex. As far as capex is concerned, based on our MSA, whichever rates are to be revised on capex, wherever we have that flexibility, that is accordingly adjusted for the customers.

product_mix.statement: IBS deployments gaining market share for two consecutive years; provided solutions for India Mobile Congress and Vizag Airport
product_mix.quote: Supported by a specialized team focused on design and execution, the company has led incremental market share gains in new IBS deployments for two consecutive years and remains focused on expanding its presence in this segment while enhancing the end user connectivity experience.

risk.statement: Africa expansion at early stage; meaningful metrics to be shared in subsequent quarters as portfolio reaches representative scale
risk.quote: As the portfolio reaches to a more representative scale, we intend to share more detail on operational and financial metrics in subsequent quarters.

other.statement: Tenancy ratio improved from 1.62 to 1.63 driven by sharing of existing towers
other.quote: Our industry -leading tenancy ratio has also improved from 1.62 to 1.63, driven by substantial rollout through sharing of our existing towers.

other.statement: Government support for smart meter deployment on telecom towers; ~140,000 sites deployed over 3 years
other.quote: Government support for smart meter deployment on telecom towers has further reinforced telecom infrastructure as a priority consumer category. Over the last three years, we have deployed smart meters on approximately 140,000 sites.

guidance.statement: Revenue growth guidance revised to early 20s percent for FY27 from prior mid-teens to high teens
guidance.quote: I had said mid-teens to high teens. I think now I think early 20s is a good estimate of where we think we'll end the year.

guidance.statement: EBITDA margin long-term guidance anchored at 31-31.5% while funding growth investments
guidance.quote: I would say a long- term guidance of about 31%, 31.5%, where we are funding all these investments for growth is what I would anchor on, right, and not above that.

guidance.statement: Specialty diagnostics target 10-15% of revenue in 3-5 year horizon
guidance.quote: As I said, in a 3 to 5-year horizon, specialty should be at least around 10% to 15% of our revenue, and we'll hold to that.

guidance.statement: API Group ex-Thyrocare profitability target by Q4 FY27 before any corporate action discussion
guidance.quote: I have guided to API Group ex-Thyrocare turning profitable by Q4 FY27. It is only by then that I think even any kind of corporate action would be in the realm of discussion.

demand.statement: Pathology business grew 27% YoY in Q2 FY27; test volumes up 27%, patients up 13%, tests per patient up 12%
demand.quote: Continuing the growth momentum of over 20% achieved in each of the past 2 years, our pathology business grew even faster in Q2 FY27, delivering 27% growth.

order_book.statement: Active franchisee base reached 12,911 with record 1,180 net additions in Q2 FY27
order_book.quote: We added about 1,180 franchises in the quarter, our highest quarterly addition in 3 years, taking the active base of franchise to a record of 12,911.

capex.statement: H1 FY27 capex of INR30 crores for 8 new labs and capacity; similar capex expected in H2
capex.quote: During H1 FY27, a capex of INR30 crores has been invested on account of new lab expansion, 5 in this quarter and 3 in quarter 1 and capacity capex to support 27% volume growth. In balance part of the financial year, we are expecting a similar capex investm ent for the growth of the business

pricing_cost.statement: Pregnancy kit gross margin comparable to diagnostics business; EBITDA margin normalized comparable but not EPS accretive for 3 quarters due to marketing spend
pricing_cost.quote: From an economic standpoint, I would say gross margin of this business is more or less comparable to our diagnostics business. And the EBITDA margin of this business is also at a normalized level comparable to our pathology business.

product_mix.statement: Pregnancy test kit available in 10,000+ pharmacies via Ascent distribution; listed on PharmEasy and quick commerce platforms
product_mix.quote: Today, we are already present in 10,000-plus pharmacies.
